title: The rectangle passes to the derived limit
statement:
Use the four corner towers $A_\bullet,B_\bullet,C_\bullet,D_\bullet\in D(\operatorname{Tow}_A(Y'))$ and the compatible morphisms $h:A_\bullet\to B_\bullet$, $v:A_\bullet\to C_\bullet$, $h':C_\bullet\to D_\bullet$, $v':B_\bullet\to D_\bullet$ of [lem-weil-pbc-tower-compatibility]. Fix the triangulated derived-limit functor $F=\Rlim$ of [prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality], with its natural Roos triangles [prop-weil-pbc-roos-triangle], and put
$$
 A_\infty=F(A_\bullet),\quad B_\infty=F(B_\bullet),\quad C_\infty=F(C_\bullet),\quad D_\infty=F(D_\bullet).
$$
Let $H=F(h)$, $V=F(v)$, $H'=F(h')$, $V'=F(v')$. Then
$$
 V'H=H'V:A_\infty\longrightarrow D_\infty.
$$
For any one of these towers $M_\bullet$, let $\operatorname{pr}_{M,n}:M_\infty\to M_n$ be the first map of its natural Roos triangle followed by the $n$-th product projection. For every $n\geq1$, the component assertion means precisely
$$
 \operatorname{pr}_{D,n}V'H
 =v'_nh_n\operatorname{pr}_{A,n}
 =h'_nv_n\operatorname{pr}_{A,n}
 =\operatorname{pr}_{D,n}H'V.
$$

note:
*Source note:* the assertion is the functoriality of the derived limit of
Stacks Project, Derived Categories, Definition 13.34.1 ([Tag
08TC](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08TC)), whose triangle is natural
in the system, so that a functorial model of $\Rlim$ carries compatible
tower morphisms to morphisms and preserves composition. The Stacks entry
states the triangle for one system; the blueprint adds the assembly over the
tower category, the functoriality of the sequential derived inverse limit
proved above, and the identification of the $n$-th components of both sides
with the finite-level equations $v'_nh_n=h'_nv_n$.

proof.text: The theorem takes the compatible tower arrows, their rectangle equality, the triangulated functor F, and the natural Roos first arrow p as hypotheses. Apply congrArg F.map to hrectangle and rewrite Functor.map_comp to obtain the rectangle in the derived module category itself. No construction or existence theorem is invoked.

source.place: Rectangle and finite-level component assertions; elementary functoriality and naturality

proof.text: For any tower arrow f : M to N, postcompose p.naturality f with the n-th product projection. Unfold pbcRoosProjection and the map of pbcTowerProduct, then use Pi.map_π and associativity to get F.map f followed by pr_N,n = pr_M,n followed by the n-th component of pbcDerivedEvaluation.map f. Apply this identity to h followed by v-prime and to v followed by h-prime, and rewrite functoriality and NatTrans.comp_app. Apply congrArg to hrectangle using evaluation at n, then precompose with pr_A,n, to obtain the middle equality. These are equalities of arrows into the n-th evaluated tower object; equality of limit arrows is never inferred from component equality.

lean.statement: theorem pbcRectangleDerivedLimit (T : Scheme.{u}) {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (d : Scheme.AdicCoefficientDatum R) (A B C D : DerivedCategory (Scheme.CompletedAdicTowers T d)) (h : A ⟶ B) (v : A ⟶ C) (h' : C ⟶ D) (v' : B ⟶ D) (hrectangle : h ≫ v' = v ≫ h') (F : DerivedCategory (Scheme.CompletedAdicTowers T d) ⥤ DerivedCategory (Scheme.CompletedAdicModules T d)) [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated] (p : F ⟶ pbcTowerProduct T d) (δ : pbcTowerProduct T d ⟶ F ⋙ shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory (Scheme.CompletedAdicModules T d)) (1 : ℤ)) (_hRoos : ∀ M : DerivedCategory (Scheme.CompletedAdicTowers T d), IsDerivedLimitTriangle (fun n : ℕ ↦ ((pbcDerivedEvaluation T d).obj M).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) (F.obj M) (p.app M) (δ.app M)) : (F.map h ≫ F.map v' = F.map v ≫ F.map h') ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, ((F.map h ≫ F.map v') ≫ pbcRoosProjection T d F p D n = pbcRoosProjection T d F p A n ≫ ((pbcDerivedEvaluation T d).map h).app (op n) ≫ ((pbcDerivedEvaluation T d).map v').app (op n)) ∧ (pbcRoosProjection T d F p A n ≫ ((pbcDerivedEvaluation T d).map h).app (op n) ≫ ((pbcDerivedEvaluation T d).map v').app (op n) = pbcRoosProjection T d F p A n ≫ ((pbcDerivedEvaluation T d).map v).app (op n) ≫ ((pbcDerivedEvaluation T d).map h').app (op n)) ∧ (pbcRoosProjection T d F p A n ≫ ((pbcDerivedEvaluation T d).map v).app (op n) ≫ ((pbcDerivedEvaluation T d).map h').app (op n) = (F.map v ≫ F.map h') ≫ pbcRoosProjection T d F p D n)

blueprint_update.statement:
Put
$$
 A_\infty=\Rlim A_\bullet,\quad
 B_\infty=\Rlim B_\bullet,\quad
 C_\infty=\Rlim C_\bullet,\quad
 D_\infty=\Rlim D_\bullet,
$$
and let $H,V,H',V'$ be the images under the triangulated functor $\Rlim$ ([prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality]) of
the four compatible tower morphisms $h,v,h',v'$. Then
$$
 V'H=H'V:A_\infty\longrightarrow D_\infty.
$$
The $n$-th component of both sides is the equality $v'_nh_n=h'_nv_n$ at
level $n$.

proof.text:
The triangle functor $\Rlim$ of the derived inverse limit preserves the
rectangle commutation of [lem-weil-pbc-tower-compatibility], and evaluation
at $n$ recovers the finite-level equality.
